comment: Ignore list and hints for scripts/sql_live_check.py (live PostgreSQL validation). 'untyped' = keys (file|hash of the statement text, no line numbers) of statements whose parameter types PostgreSQL cannot infer: harmless noise because psycopg2 sends literals; regenerate with: PGSSLMODE=require python scripts/sql_live_check.py --write-baseline. 'accepted_errors' = {key, reason} of REAL findings that were triaged as false positives (none today). 'placeholder_hints' resolve f-string parts the static extractor cannot see: key '<file>::<expr>' (or '<expr>'), a list of candidate texts; candidate i of every placeholder of a statement is used together in rendering i and EVERY rendering must prepare. The token __SCHEMA__ stands for the scratch schema.
